messages:
viv: RFC follow-up: tossing out an alternate approach to the usual arbiter/evict story — 'probe-fusion + adaptive throttle' for canaries. Aim: reduce noisy hardFallbacks while keeping rollback fast.

hugo: curious. TL;DR of probe-fusion?

viv: instead of single-metric decisions, we fuse multiple probes (latency, error-rate, tail-retry, kv-mismatch) into a short-lived local sketch and publish a fused score. Router uses score + local queue depth to pick action.

tara: so decision is (action, fused_score, throttle_pct, decision_id, ttl)? what are actions?

viv: yep. Actions: OK (no change), THROTTLE (reduce new assigns to variant by X%), QUARANTINE (route new requests to fallback variant but allow finish), DRAIN_FAST (accelerate drains for low-tail tenants).

infra-bot: staged canary r-4212 started cohort=probe-fusion @5860001120

hugo: important: throttle_pct should be probabilistic and applied at bind-time with seeded RNG so behavior is reproducible. Also include a backoff ramp so throttle increases only after sustained degraded fused_score.

viv: agreed. Envelope sketch in RFC (simplified): `decision_id, tenant, action, fused_score, throttle_pct, drain_until, ttl_secs, signer, api_version, reason`. Router respects ttl and caches signed decisions.

tara: how do we compute fused_score without adding central latency? local sketch at edge?

viv: local sketch + lightweight aggregator in arbiter. Router computes local features (queue depth, recent p95/p99 delta, kv-errors) and sends a small probe to aggregator async. Arbiter returns fused_score used for near-term decision; if arbiter slow, router can fallback to local heuristic and emit decision_miss metric.

hugo: what about rollback speed? THROTTLE buys us time, but if fused_score continues to degrade we need an escalation path to QUARANTINE/DRAIN_FAST. Add hysteresis: require sustained window or high-confidence spike. Manual overrides still immediate.

ops-bot: alert: r-4212 observed p95 jump @5860001142

tara: for streaming/KV concerns: QUARANTINE should never forcibly close streams. It only affects new binds and returns 503 for attach attempts to old variant. Add per-tenant max-active cap to prevent long-tail stalls.

viv: add compatibility_label in envelope to avoid mixing cache-incompatible variants. Also include `probe_vector` (list of contributing metric names) for audit logs.

hugo: migration plan: 1) feature-flag arbiter-fusion; 2) opt-in tenants get fused decisions mirrored to controller for 48h; 3) diff job; 4) promote if mismatch < threshold. Router keeps kill-switch: ignore arbiter decisions if mismatch rate > 1% in 5m.

tara: telemetry: emit fused_score{tenant,action} and throttle_applied{tenant,router,pct}. Also rollout_heartbeat and decision_miss_count. Add a debug dry-run mode where router logs what it would have done at bind-time.

viv: security: decisions signed (JWT) w/ kid and signer_version. Include decision_id in request traces to make forensics easier.

hugo: open Q: how to tune default throttle curves per-tenant? My proposal: default conservative curve (5% -> 25% -> 50% over 3 escalation steps) but allow tenant override. Include a simulation harness in RFC for SLO impact.

viv: good. I'll include a sample curl to fetch decision and a small sim script in the RFC. Will draft and ping #eng-platform. Thanks.

tara: :thumbsup:
